post.caption: A Princess Margaret tiara had a screwdriver. Garrard made the tiara in 1870 for Lady Poltimore, whose husband was Treasurer to Queen Victoria's household. In January 1959, the family sold it at auction, and Princess Margaret acquired it on the advice of Lord Plunket. The tiara converts into a necklace and eleven brooches, and its case holds a small screwdriver and the brooch fittings. She wore it as a necklace before the wedding, then as a tiara at the 1960 wedding. It sold at Christie's in 2006 for 926,400 pounds.
